programme.title: Aneeka se kombuis

programme.title: Kom Ons Braai
programme.desc: 'S18/E9'. Drie spanne van Gauteng ding mee vir die braaikroon vanaand. Gaan die kos lekker proe? Gaan die punte regverdig wees? Kom kuier saam.

programme.title: Kom Ons Braai
programme.desc: 'S18/E10'. In die Wes-Kaap braai Hermanus en Kleinmond se spanne teen mekaar en die gasvryheid het geen perke nie.

programme.title: Kom Ons Braai
programme.desc: 'S18/E11'. In die Kaap tussen Bellville en Brackenfell brand die vure hoog en die kompetisie is aan. Spanne loop oor warm kole om mekaar te beïndruk, maar wie klim uiteindelik bo op die braaipodium?

programme.title: Kom Ons Braai
programme.desc: 'S18/E12'. Vanaand kuier ons in die Vaaldriehoek waar spanne van Sasolburg en Vanderbijlpark mekaar aanvat in 'n braaikompetisie. Kom kyk hoe spat die vonke!

programme.title: Hier Sit Die Manne
programme.desc: 'S10/E9'. Van onderwyser na Atlantiese avonturier - Peter van Kets kuier vandag by Frank. Ons leer hoe om werkstres beter te hanteer, en kry 4x4-wenke vir vassit.

programme.title: Herman Se Tafel

programme.title: Erfenis in die grond
programme.desc: 'S1/E4'. Boompie Alleen: Hierdie week is ons in Vrede in die Vrystaat en ontmoet die Fourie-familie, wat al vir vyf generasies met beeste en sojabone boer.

programme.title: Dr. Nou
programme.desc: 'S7/E5'. Kristen, 'n toegewyde ma van 3, het haar eie gesondheid opgeoffer terwyl sy deur jare van uitdagings en gesinsverantwoordelikhede gegaan het.

programme.desc: 'S11/E13'. Ons herleef dié eeu oue tydskrif se dramatiese en ikoniese stories. Ons besoek die karakters, kenners en joernaliste agter die stories.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S12/E1'. 'n Geweldadige reeksmisdadiger word skokkend genoeg op borg vrygelaat na poging tot verkragting. Ingrid Koch betaal met haar lewe wanneer sy en haar man op hulle plaas aangeval word.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S12/E2'. Kyle Ruiters was van jongs af gefassineerd met reeksmoordenaars. Wanneer hy uiteindelik besluit om Lynette Volschenk te teiken, wonder mens of daar ooit hoop was vir die jong man.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas

programme.title: Die Klein Groot Verskil
programme.desc: 'S1/E3'. Zetske van Pletzen en Dr Mark Opperman bespreek hoe om 'n gesonde leefstyl aan te vul. Hul gesels met gaste Esti en Cheralee oor hulle persoonlike struikelblokke en Zetske leer hoe om gesonde maaltye voor te berei.

programme.title: 'n Nuwe jy met Nova
programme.desc: 'S2/E5'. Op die oog af het jong mamma Chante Serfontein alles onder beheer, maar onder die oppervlak skuil onsekerhede en innerlike seer. Elana help haar om haar vel én haar hart 'n nuwe lus vir die lewe te gee.

programme.desc: 'S31/E3'. Kenneth en Joanne Ball is die rentmeesters van die omgewingskat Shi-awela by Bandelierkop in Limpopo. Hulle spits hulself toe op die Amerikaanse mark vir hul jagsafari's, en Nguni's speel ook 'n belangrike rol in veldbestuur.

programme.desc: 'S2/E7'. Vir die laaste episode is JP op sy eie energie aangewese. Hy besoek Overhex-wyne in Worcester, waar hy glo wyn uit die tenk mors.

programme.title: Kom Ons Braai
programme.desc: 'S11/E2'. Ons gunstelingtydverdryf is nou 'n sosiale eksperiment. Drie paartjies wat mekaar nie ken nie, braai by mekaar en heelwat gebeur om die vuur. En ons praat nie net van die lekker kos nie!

programme.title: Aneeka se kombuis
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. Hierdie week kook Aneeka herinneringe - met 'n bietjie spice daarby! Dis Oupa se smoortjie, Ouma se breyani en Ma se sterk opinies, soos onthou en gedeel deur haar spesiale gas. In Aneeka se kombuis is daar liefde op elke bord.

programme.title: Huis SOS
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. Aanbieder Leon Gropp help Pieter en Lotie Koen om hul nuwe huis in te rig met splinternuwe meubels. 'n Tuinstel kry 'n vars voorkoms met poeierbedekking, en Leon vind ook uit watter handige produkte jy nodig het wanneer jy trek.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Prologue
programme.desc: Prologue. The first contests on this year's edition of the Dakar took place at the gateway to the city of Bisha, on a terrain with a sequence of sandy tracks.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 1
programme.desc: Stage 1. Travelling south from Bisha, the air gets thinner and thinner as the road approaches 1,300 metres. The drop in oxygen levels is barely noticeable, but the landscape is no longer the same.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 2A
programme.desc: Stage 2A. The return journey to Bisha to complete the 48 HR Chrono expedition to the northeast of the city required passing through a 90-kilometre portion of grey dunes.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 2B
programme.desc: Stage 2B. The return journey to Bisha to complete the 48 HR Chrono expedition to the northeast of the city required passing through a 90-kilometre portion of grey dunes.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 3
programme.desc: Stage 3. The riders, drivers and crews dropped down by about 500 metres in altitude and especially had to tackle a beginning to the special that was very rocky, before picking up speed on sandy plateaus for approximately 200 kilometres.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 4
programme.desc: Stage 4. Prior to camping out in Berber tents, the competitors weaved their way around canyons, surged up rocky plateaus and turned on the afterburners on flat sandy expanses.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 5
programme.desc: Stage 5. The navigation was tricky on the last part of the special, where taking care of tyres was especially important on the terrain made up of large gravel.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Rest Day
programme.desc: Rest Day. 2025 will be the 47th edition of the Dakar Rally, organized by Amaury Sport Organisation (ASO), and the 6th time Saudi Arabia has hosted the event.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 6
programme.desc: Stage 6. Clarity of mind was essential to finding the way out of this maze of dunes ranging from white to saffron yellow depending on the angle of the light or the composition of the sand.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 7
programme.desc: Stage 7. The stage dazzled with views of Riyadh Province after rolling out of Al Duwadimi for a wide loop to the south-west of the city, stretching for a shade over 410 km.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 8
programme.desc: Stage 8. The day's special took place to the south of the capital, on split routes for the FIM and FIA vehicles, but both over distances of more than 480 kilometres.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 9
programme.desc: Stage 9. Over a distance of 357 kilometres and at a high pace requiring speedy roadbook reading, the main pitfalls to be concerned about was in regards to navigation.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 10
programme.desc: Stage 10. The field rolled out of Haradh to tackle a road section of more than 500 kilometres on route to the shores of the Arabian Gulf.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 11
programme.desc: Stage 11. There was a delay to the start of the stage which incited the bikers to request that the stage be shortened to 152km instead of the original 308km.

programme.title: Dakar HL '25: Stage 12
programme.desc: Stage 12. The 47th edition of the Dakar and the 6th in Saudi Arabia was completed in Shubaytah by 175 vehicles - 77 bikes, 40 Ultimate cars, 1 Stock car, 21 Challengers, 23 SSVs and 13 trucks.

programme.desc: Event. 2025 will be the 47th edition of the Dakar Rally, organized by Amaury Sport Organisation (ASO), and the 6th time Saudi Arabia has hosted the event.
